wholePhysicalScope: The 31-vertex OpenStreetMap outline supplies the whole site envelope, roundabout elevation, two tower projections, entrance and rear volume. The join separating the historic hall and expansion is approximate.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the two domed towers, copper mansards and rear wing. Closer levels refine dormers, rusticated stone courses and window frames.
limitations: The exact June 2025 Qualla image supports the northwestern exterior. Written accounts and the mapped frontage support the paired towers, mansard forms and entrance. Exact fenestration, heights, copper color variation and rear elevations are estimated.
The independent site field uses public composite elevation data. Threshold and exposed foundation heights are approximate. The museum sculpture and interiors are outside the model scope.
